headline: Herb v0.9: the ERB toolchain that gives the Rails frontend real IDE support
summary: A fast C-based HTML+ERB parser that now understands Action View helpers like tag.*, content_tag, and link_to. As Hotwire pushes more UI logic into ERB, Herb brings the linting, formatting, and code intelligence that JS frameworks take for granted — and gives AI coding tools a proper AST to work with instead of raw string matching.

headline: Claude Code adds Ruby LSP to its official plugin directory
summary: Anthropic merges Ruby LSP into its official Claude Code plugins, giving Ruby developers one-command install for go-to-definition, hover, and diagnostics — 900x faster than text search for finding call sites.

headline: Intercom raises $250M as ARR tops $400M — all on a Rails monolith
summary: The Rails Foundation Core member secures $250M in debt financing. Its 2M-line Rails monolith powers Fin, an AI agent nearing $100M ARR on its own. Plans to hire 650 globally.

headline: YC CEO Garry Tan ships garryslist.org with Rails + Claude Code, open-sources his setup
summary: Garry Tan averages 10K LOC and 100 PRs/week building a Rails app with Claude Code. Open-sourced gstack — 6 Claude Code skills for planning, review, and shipping. "Rails was designed for syntactic sugar, and LLMs are sugar fiends."

headline: Chime targets GAAP profitability in 2026, projecting $2.6B+ revenue
summary: The Rails-powered fintech that IPO'd at $11.6B reports 31% revenue growth and 9.5M active members. Rails Foundation Contributing member on track to become one of the largest profitable public Rails companies.

headline: Chatwoot trending: 27.7K GitHub stars for the open-source Rails alternative to Intercom
summary: The YC-backed, Rails-powered customer support platform is the fastest-growing Ruby repo on GitHub this month (+490 stars). Built by a 10-person team doing $870K in revenue.

headline: Lago launches Embedded — white-label open-source billing built on Rails
summary: The open-source billing API (9K+ GitHub stars) launches Lago Embedded, letting companies ship billing as a feature in weeks. PayPal is an early adopter. Built in Ruby by a team with 10 years of Rails experience.

headline: Spring Health acquires Alma — combined $6–7B entity, $1B revenue in year one
summary: The Rails-powered mental health platform (50M+ lives covered) acquires Alma's therapist network (120M+ lives). Nearly 10M mental health visits projected for 2026. SF office at 2 Embarcadero Center.

headline: GitLab surpasses $1B ARR — authorizes $400M share buyback
summary: Rails Foundation Core member crosses the $1B ARR milestone. Full-year revenue $955M (+26%). Added most $1M+ customers ever in Q4. Free cash flow grew 83% to $220M.

headline: Apollo.io launches AI Assistant — first agentic GTM platform, built on Rails monolith
summary: SF-based $1.6B sales intelligence platform — powered by a Rails monolith serving 210M+ contacts — launches its AI Assistant out of beta. 20K weekly active users, 2.3x more meetings booked. Also launched a native Anthropic Claude connector.

headline: Shopify Winter '26 Edition: 150+ updates, Agentic Storefronts, $3.67B/quarter
summary: Rails Foundation Core member ships 150+ product updates including Agentic Storefronts (products in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot) and Sidekick AI app builder. Revenue $3.67B (+31%), GMV hit $124B. Authorized $2B share buyback.

headline: Omada Health reports first profitable quarter — 58% revenue growth
summary: SF-based Rails company reports Q4 revenue of $75.8M (+58% YoY), its first profitable quarter with $5.16M net income. Membership grew 55% to 886K. Stock surged 14%. Guiding $312–322M for 2026.

headline: Checkr launches AI identity verification to combat deepfake hiring fraud
summary: SF-based Rails company launches IDV product with biometric liveness detection and forensic document analysis. Built with Socure. Also partners with Intuit to embed background checks in QuickBooks for 120K+ businesses.
